name: toolchains
description: Compiled language and build tool failures.

rules.title: Rust cannot find the system linker
rules.summary: rustc produced objects, but the native linker or C toolchain is unavailable.
causes: The platform C/C++ build tools are missing.
A custom linker setting points to an unavailable executable.
actions: Install the supported native build tools for the Rust target.
Inspect target-specific linker settings in Cargo and environment configuration.

rules.title: go.sum is missing a required module entry
rules.summary: The module graph needs a checksum that is absent from the committed go.sum file.

any: missing go\.sum entry for module providing package
updates to go\.mod needed; to update it

causes: A dependency import changed without updating module metadata.
Readonly module mode is active in CI.
actions: Use the repository's expected Go version.
Run the suggested go mod command in a trusted checkout, review go.mod and go.sum, and commit the intended changes.

rules.title: The Java runtime is older than the compiled classes
rules.summary: The class-file version was produced by a newer Java release than the active runtime supports.

any: class file version .+, this version of the Java Runtime only recognizes

causes: Build and runtime jobs use different Java releases.
A dependency was compiled for a newer Java baseline.
actions: Compare java -version and javac -version in the failing environment.
Run with a compatible newer JRE, or compile the project and dependencies for the intended target release.

rules.title: Gradle cannot use the configured Java home
rules.summary: JAVA_HOME or Gradle's Java installation path does not point to a usable JDK.

any: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory
Supplied javaHome is not a valid folder

causes: The JDK moved or was removed.
JAVA_HOME points to a JRE, executable, or version-specific path that no longer exists.
actions: Locate the intended JDK root and confirm its bin/java executable works.
Update the narrow project or shell setting that supplied the stale path.
